_README: Video settings for an RTX 5070 (12 GB) + Ryzen 7 7700X at 2560x1440, 240 Hz, competitive (latency first, then clarity). menu = the in-game Settings > Video label and value. keys = the Source 2 video file keys tools/dl_video.py sets, ONLY when the key already exists in the file the game wrote (it never adds a key). See docs/optimization.md.

menu.Upscaling: Off (native); DLSS Quality only if 1 percent lows fall under 160 fps
menu.Anti-Aliasing: Low or Off if Upscaling is On
